_signals.x_guidance: Use POST /api/x402/v1/detect-file-type to detect the likely real file type. Use POST /api/x402/v1/convert-file to start an asynchronous conversion job. POST /convert-file requires the uploaded file, target_format, filename, created_at, and size_bytes. It returns a job_id and status_url; it does not return the converted file or result_url immediately. Poll GET /api/x402/v1/convert-file/{job_id}/status until status is done or failed. If status is done, the status response includes result_url. Call result_url and pay the x402 exact result price. Result pricing is tiered and predictable: 0.02 USDC for files up to 10 MB, 0.04 USDC for files over 10 MB and up to 40 MB. After successful payment, the result endpoint returns a short-lived download_url.
